ZAF.note: Only lists authentication products as an optional SITA service; no service stated in use or under way.
Only says SITA is mandated to provide interoperability standards; no standards named or published.

facts.fact: Statistics SA's Statistician-General said in a reply signed 11 November 2024 that under the SITA Act the State Information Technology Agency must provide national and provincial departments with a private telecoms network and transversal and department-specific information systems (Persal, BAS, LOGIS), and data processing for them.
